intro.text: Lord Haltier Habren, a young noble member of the Luthadel Assembly.

items.text: In the election to replace the deposed Elend Venture as king, he was one of only two votes for Ashweather Cett. With the vote heading for deadlock, he asked whether he could change his vote since Cett clearly couldn't win; when Elend said he could, he and Lord Hue switched to Ferson Penrod, ensuring Penrod's victory.
